notes: PhD programmes at Utrecht University are conducted in English, and candidates are admitted as employees via job vacancies or as scholarship/externally funded/external candidates registered in MyPhD. Under the 2025 Doctoral Degree Regulations (Promotiereglement) and Executive Board quality-assurance rules, a Master's or equivalent degree is required, while specific admission/English criteria are set per Graduate School.
